judgments.reason: The support_span 'The tumor cells exhibited clear cell borders' describes distinct cell membranes/boundaries between cells, not the clear cytoplasm (glycogen- or lipid-rich, optically empty cytoplasm) that defines the clear cell histological subtype of hepatocellular carcinoma. Clear cell borders are a general morphological feature and do not clinically support a clear cell subtype designation; the vignette contains no description of pale, vacuolated, or optically clear cytoplasm that would be required to support this modifier.
